environment.description: Same container image deployed on ECS Fargate but the task definition specifies a custom Linux namespace configuration. The container entrypoint is wrapped with a pivot_root into /app/sandbox prior to JVM startup via a static init binary. The pivot_root target (/app/sandbox) is a minimal tmpfs containing only the JRE, application JAR, and an empty /app/workspace/artifacts mount. The old root is unmounted (not just moved) before the JVM process starts. Additionally, the container's seccomp profile (applied via ECS task definition dockerSecurityOpt) restricts symlink-related syscalls (symlink, symlinkat, link, linkat) to return EPERM. The process runs as uid 65534 (nobody) with no-new-privileges flag set. The /app/sandbox filesystem has no sensitive files — /etc contains only nsswitch.conf and resolv.conf stubs, there is no /root directory, and no credential files exist anywhere in the namespace.

config.seccomp_profile: custom-artifact-processor.json (blocks symlink, symlinkat, link, linkat syscalls)
config.filesystem_contents: JRE runtime, application JAR, empty workspace directory, minimal /etc stubs only
config.sensitive_files_present: none — no credentials, no shadow file, no config secrets within namespace
